svg.title: Responders compare three evidence cards
svg.desc: Give the three evidence cards equal space on the shared table, with responders around rather than above them. Collective comparison must remain distinct from a heroic investigator reveal. Reuse the flat lights and blank telemetry wall through the response sequence; background screens introduce no additional findings.
